evidence.reason: The helper-load boundary catches only OSError from read_bytes(); the compile/exec at line 82 is outside any try/except. A readable helper with invalid syntax therefore raises SyntaxError before the normal Refused/JSON error path. In --json mode that leaves stdout empty and sends a traceback to stderr, contrary to the I1 machine-mode contract. Catch SyntaxError at this boundary and raise Refused, preserving the existing hash-before-exec order.
